# S141 — Approval card follow-ups: ork check/fix CLI, note for unreadable checks, fix note in later gate briefs, checks 10+, refused-action wording, duplicate note

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**2026-10-28** — S141 implementer, known limits left as they are: (1) launchRun clears r.failure before the job runs, so a refusal that follows a real failure removes the earlier error marker from the run row (save and restore would fix it). (2) The checks-note guard (Engine.noted) lives in one engine instance, so a daemon restart between a failed approval save and the retry writes the note again; a mark changed after a failed approval writes a second, different note. (3) There is no real-daemon round-trip test for ork fix / run.fix on the CLI side; the CLI tests use a scripted Call and the daemon tests cover run.fix. (4) ork check prints only 'RUN awaiting-approval'; it could name the check and the checks still open. (5) A card with more than about 9 checks is cut at 80x24 with no '+N more' marker. (6) The Overview's three blank lines push Recent further down (+5 more lines at 120x40 in the approval card golden).

## Implement

Re-anchor from the code after S118 and S148 (approval and card code changed). Owner decisions 2026-10-26: add ork check and ork fix CLI so ork approve works from the shell with human checks; when checks cannot be read at approval, approve and write a slicer note saying so.
